snippet.title: Rodent Company - Trailer
snippet.description:
🔫 Rodent Company | Official Trailer | Pixel Art Roguelike Co-Op Shooter! 🐀

Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with up to 4 friends in local co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

Wishlist on Steam NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3764550/Rodent_Company/

🚀 Early Access April 2026: Basic biomes, enemies, initial ending + 7 characters, 30+ weapons, 96+ perks, 60+ modules. Core mechanics at launch and more updates ahead!

⭐ Wishlist & Subscribe for updates!
